title.ja: 駅で切符を買って乗り方を聞く

summary.ja: 切符を買って、発車時間やホーム、乗り換えを聞く。
summary.en: Buy a ticket and ask about times, platforms and changing trains.

setting: The ticket office at Central Station in a city abroad, at 10 a.m. on a weekday. A traveller wants to go to Lakeside, a town about an hour away, for a day trip.

roles.persona: A Japanese traveller on a day trip to Lakeside.

levels.tutor: You are the station staff at the ticket office. Speak slowly, in short simple sentences, one thing at a time. Ask single or return, and use the timetable: the next train is the 10:15 from platform 4.

hints: 行き先を言って切符を買いましょう
One ticket to …, please.
One ticket to Lakeside, please.
片道か往復か伝えましょう
Single / Return, please.
Return, please.

title.ja: 次の電車の時間を聞く
title.en: Ask when the next train is

hints: 次の電車の時間を聞きましょう
When is the …?
When is the next train?
何番ホームか聞きましょう
Which platform …?
Which platform is it?

levels.tutor: You are the station staff, speaking at a natural but clear pace. Use the timetable: the 10:15 is direct from platform 4; the 10:45 needs a change at Hill Park. Mention that they scan their ticket at the gates.

hints: 往復の切符をお願いしましょう
Could I get a return ticket to …?
Could I get a return ticket to Lakeside, please?
次の電車の時間を聞きましょう
When's the next train to …?
When's the next train to Lakeside?

title.ja: 乗り換えがあるか聞く
title.en: Ask if you need to change

hints: 乗り換えが必要か聞きましょう
Do I need to …?
Do I need to change trains?
何番ホームか聞きましょう
Which platform does it …?
Which platform does it leave from?

levels.tutor: You are a helpful station staff member, speaking at natural speed. Use the timetable and the fares. If they ask about a cheaper ticket, explain the off-peak return ($32): they can't travel back between 16:00 and 19:00. Mention that they scan their ticket at the gates.

title.ja: 予定を伝えて切符を買う
title.en: Buy a ticket for your plans

hints: 往復で、夜に帰ってくると伝えましょう
I'd like a return to … I'm coming back …
I'd like a return to Lakeside. I'm coming back this evening.

title.ja: 安い切符があるか聞く

hints: もっと安い切符がないか聞きましょう
Is there a cheaper … if …?
Is there a cheaper ticket if I travel outside rush hour?

title.ja: 直通の電車を確認する

hints: 次の直通の電車を聞きましょう
Is the next train …?
Is the next train to Lakeside a direct one?

title.ja: ホームと乗り方を確認する

hints: ホームと、改札で何をするか聞きましょう
Which platform …, and do I need to …?
Which platform is it, and do I need to show my ticket at the gate?

twist.tutor: Check your screen and apologise: the 10:15 has just been cancelled. Explain the choices from the timetable: the 10:45 with a change at Hill Park (arriving 12:05), or the direct 11:15 (arriving 12:20).

hints: どの電車にするか決めて伝えましょう
Then I'll take the … and …
Then I'll take the 10:45 and change at Hill Park.

roles.persona: A member of staff at the Central Station ticket office.

levels.tutor: You are a traveller who wants a return ticket to Lakeside. Speak slowly and simply, and wait for the staff to ask you things. Ask which platform the train leaves from.

hints: 行き先を聞きましょう
Hello! Where …?
Hello! Where are you going?
片道か往復か聞きましょう
Single or …?
Single or return?
料金を伝えましょう
That's … dollars, please.
That's 40 dollars, please.
何番ホームか伝えましょう
It's platform …
It's platform 4.

levels.tutor: You are a traveller going to Lakeside for the day, speaking at natural pace. Buy a return ticket, ask when the next train is, and ask whether you need to change.

title.en: Ask where they'd like to go

hints: 行き先を聞きましょう
Where would you …?
Where would you like to go today?
次の電車の時間を伝えましょう
The next train is at …
The next train is at 10:15.

title.ja: 乗り換えについて答える

hints: 直通で乗り換えはないと伝えましょう
It's … You don't need to …
It's direct. You don't need to change.

title.ja: 改札の通り方を説明する

hints: 改札で切符をかざすと伝えましょう
Just scan … at the …
Just scan your ticket at the gates.

levels.tutor: You are a traveller on a budget, speaking at natural speed. You want the 10:15 to Lakeside and to come back in the evening, around 20:00. Ask for the cheapest ticket. You haven't heard that the 10:15 is cancelled.

hints: オフピークの往復券を説明しましょう
An off-peak return is … but you can't …
An off-peak return is 32 dollars, but you can't come back between four and seven.
ていねいに謝って、運休を伝えましょう
I'm sorry, the … has been …
I'm sorry, the 10:15 has been cancelled.

title.ja: ほかの電車を案内する

hints: 乗り換えありの電車と、次の直通を案内しましょう
You can take the … and change at …, or wait for …
You can take the 10:45 and change at Hill Park, or wait for the 11:15.
選んだ電車のホームを伝えましょう
The … leaves from platform …
The 10:45 leaves from platform 2.

prop.title: CENTRAL STATION · Trains to Lakeside
prop.foot: Scan your ticket at the gates · Last train back from Lakeside 22:40
